before.production_unit:
[Unit]
Description=GPT-OSS 20B on Radeon 780M through llama.cpp Vulkan
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target
Conflicts=ollama.service

[Service]
Type=simple
User=tom
SupplementaryGroups=render video
WorkingDirectory=/home/tom/.local/lib/llama.cpp/releases/b11429/llama-b11429
ExecStart=/home/tom/.local/lib/llama.cpp/releases/b11429/llama-b11429/llama-server --model /home/tom/.local/share/llama.cpp/models/gpt-oss-20b-official-MXFP4.gguf --host 0.0.0.0 --port 11434 --alias gpt-oss-minis-code:20b --parallel 1 --ctx-size 16384 --n-predict 2048 --batch-size 512 --ubatch-size 128 --n-gpu-layers all --fit off --flash-attn on --jinja --reasoning-format auto --reasoning-effort medium --threads 8 --threads-batch 8 --offline
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10
TimeoutStopSec=60
NoNewPrivileges=true
UMask=0077

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
